children.name: ignoreplayer

children.tooltip: How fast will the circle stop spinning after tilting?

children.name: sensitivity
children.title: Looseness
children.tooltip: The more loose it is, the easier it is for things to tilt it.

children.name: invert
children.title: Inverted Circle
children.tooltip: Inverts the collision so it's round on the inside instead of the outside

children.name: cx
children.title: Ellipse X Scale
children.tooltip: The collision's X scale

children.name: cy
children.title: Ellipse Y Scale
children.tooltip: The collision's Y scale

children.name: id
children.title: NPC
children.tooltip: The NPC that'll circle the circle.

children.name: angle
children.title: Starting rotation
children.tooltip: The rotation the npc spawns

children.name: direction
children.title: Direction
children.tooltip: Direction of the npc when spawned.

children.name: dontmove
children.title: Don't Move
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC spawns won't move from it's starting rotation (unless the circle's also rotating.)

children.name: ignoremove
children.title: Ignore Circle Movement
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC will ignore the circle's movement. Good for flying NPCs.

children.name: ignorecircle
children.title: Ignore Lack of Circle
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC won't turn or fall off if it reaches the edge and just float mid-air

children.name: bumpnpcs
children.title: Bump into other NPCs
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC will bump into other NPCs along the cicle. (Might get stuck tho :()

children.name: bumpwalls
children.title: Bump off of walls
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC will bump off of other non-circle walls.

children.name: height
children.title: Extra height
children.tooltip: added height when spawning. (good for flying types)

children.name: tilt
children.title: Effect tilt
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC will effect the tilt of the circle if applicable.

children.name: speedmultiplier
children.title: Speed Multiplier
children.tooltip: How much the enemies speed is multiplied.

children.name: friendly
children.title: Friendly
children.tooltip: If true, the NPC spawns as friendly.

children.name: noMoreObjInLayer
children.title: Layer is Empty Event
children.tooltip: Event to trigger when the layer is empty.

children.name: deathEventName
children.title: Death Event

children.name: talkEventName
children.title: Talk Event
children.tooltip: Event to trigger when the NPC is talked to.

children.name: msg

children.name: attachedLayerName
children.title: Attached Layer Name
children.tooltip: Attached Layer to spawn the NPC with. (If you know what you're doing, all hell will break loose)

children.name: speedx
children.title: Ignore speedX effects
children.tooltip: If true any layers that is attached to the NPC (or anyone interested in the speedX of the NPC) will see it as 0.

children.name: speedy
children.title: Ignore speedY effects

children.tooltip: The name of the event to trigger this rotation.

children.name: speed

children.tooltip: How much the angular momentum should be set

children.name: add
children.title: Additive
children.tooltip: If true, the event will add instead of set.

layout.name: jank
layout.title: Jank Limit
layout.tooltip: How steep can a slope be before it's considered jank and is turned into a solid block because of it (0 is 'I paid for ALL the slopes', 1 is a 'larger than 45 degree angle? No thank you.')

layout.name: squeeze
layout.title: Align to other blocks
layout.tooltip: When true, the circle will attempt to align and snap with other blocks near it as to prevent many bugs. It also removes the blocks that are inside of blocks. If you're moving a bunch of these at the same time and experiencing lag, you should disable this. A known issue is that if a circle is moving through blocks a lot some of the blocks that make it up go off-center a bit and get screwed up. You should disable this if the circle isn't going to overlap with any other blocks.

layout.name: cframes
layout.title: Calculation Frames
layout.tooltip: How many frames to calculate the above if true. You can lower this if it's on something that's either constantly moving or not moving at all or raise it to account for more moving parts in a level. (but more frames = more lag)

layout.name: id
layout.title: Lineguider ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of the lineguider that's going to follow the motion of this circle.

layout.name: sid
layout.title: Sending Link ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of other circles that will copy this circle's rotation. Keep at 0 for no linking.

layout.name: rid
layout.title: Recieving Link ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of the circle that this circle will copy it's movement from. Keep at 0 for no linking.

layout.name: internet
layout.title: Entangled ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of a link that every circle under said ID will share speed. Keep at 0 for no free wifi anywhere you go.

layout.name: bandwidth
layout.title: Entanglement Influence/Multiplier
layout.tooltip: How much influence does this circle have on the connection (base is 100)

layout.name: crush
layout.title: Cruel Crushing
layout.tooltip: When a circle is moving, it will try and push the player out of the way to prevent it from crushing into any blocks ahead of it. Enabling this will not allow these checks to happen.

layout.name: unslope
layout.title: Deslopify
layout.tooltip: Instead of slope blocks, the circle will use full blocks. 'Why would you ever want this???'
